fraiman_muniz_2001.title: Trimmed means for functional data
fraiman_muniz_2001.notes: Introduces marginal-integral depth (Fraiman-Muniz depth). Year is 2001, not 1991.

lopez_pintado_romo_2009.title: On the concept of depth for functional data
lopez_pintado_romo_2009.notes: Introduces band depth (BD) and modified band depth (MBD) in the same paper.

srivastava_et_al_2011.title: Registration of functional data using Fisher-Rao metric
srivastava_et_al_2011.notes: SRSF framework via Fisher-Rao metric; arXiv:1103.3817. NOT the TPAMI SRV/shape paper.

ramsay_dalzell_1991.title: Some tools for functional data analysis
ramsay_dalzell_1991.notes: Seminal FDA paper introducing FPCA and the functional linear model for scalar response. Extended in 81-03 to cover the scalar-on-function FLM trio (fregre_lm, predict_fregre_lm, fregre_cv). [VERIFIED: DOI confirmed in Phase 80 seed.]

eilers_marx_1996.title: Flexible smoothing with B-splines and penalties
eilers_marx_1996.notes: Introduces P-splines (penalised B-splines). Covers basis_nbasis_cv (GCV-based nbasis selection), P-spline fitting (pspline_fit_1d, pspline_fit_gcv), and basis-smoothed projection (smooth_basis_gcv, smooth_basis_aic, fdata_to_basis_1d, basis_to_fdata_1d).

craven_wahba_1979.title: Smoothing noisy data with spline functions
craven_wahba_1979.notes: Introduces Generalized Cross-Validation (GCV) for spline smoothing. DOI 10.1007/BF01404567 is [ASSUMED] — not landing-page-verified this session; curated:false until confirmed.

nadaraya_watson_1964.notes: Simultaneous 1964 papers: Nadaraya 'On Estimating Regression' (Theory of Probability) and Watson 'Smooth Regression Analysis' (Sankhya). Both introduce the Nadaraya-Watson kernel estimator. Soviet-era journals with no DOI assignment. curated:false — cannot DOI-verify 1964 journal articles.

ramsay_silverman_2005.title: Functional Data Analysis
ramsay_silverman_2005.notes: Canonical FDA textbook (2nd edition). DOI 10.1007/b98888 is [CITED via link.springer.com] — confirmed as the Springer book DOI. curated:false — this session cannot personally open the DOI landing page to verify author list and title exactly as printed; set curated:true after direct landing-page verification at Phase 84 review.

gervini_2008.title: Robust functional estimation using the median and spherical principal components
gervini_2008.notes: Introduces the geometric (L1) median for functional data via Weiszfeld-type iteration in function space. DOI 10.1093/biomet/asn031 is [ASSUMED] — not landing-page-verified this session; curated:false until confirmed.

cuevas_febrero_fraiman_2007.title: Robust estimation and classification for functional data via projection-based depth notions
cuevas_febrero_fraiman_2007.notes: Introduces modal depth (h-depth), random projection depth, and random Tukey depth for functional data. [CITED: link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00180-007-0053-0 — confirmed via web search; landing page not personally opened this session.] curated:false until Phase 84 direct verification.

claeskens_hubert_slaets_2014.title: Multivariate functional halfspace depth
claeskens_hubert_slaets_2014.notes: Attributed as the primary source for derivative-augmented random projection depth (RPD). fdars-core rpd.rs does not cite this paper explicitly; attribution is [ASSUMED] from the derivative-inclusive halfspace depth concept. curated:false pending fdars-core source confirmation.

dabo_gijbels_2010.notes: Spatial depth root unconfirmed against fdars-core source. fdars-core spatial.rs (0.33.0) cites only 'R depth.FSD()' — no paper reference in source comments. Attribution to Dabo-Niang & Gijbels 2010 is [ASSUMED] per 81-RESEARCH §3.3 A11. curated:false pending explicit source confirmation.

narisetty_nair_2016.title: Extremal depth for functional data and applications
narisetty_nair_2016.notes: Explicitly cited in fdars-core 0.33.0 extremal.rs module doc comment: '//! Extremal depth (Narisetty & Nair 2016).' The modified epigraph index is the MEI measure from this paper. [CITED: tandfonline.com — confirmed via web search: JASA Vol 111, No 516, 2016.] curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page verification.

sun_genton_2011.title: Functional boxplots
sun_genton_2011.notes: Introduces the functional boxplot visualization and the outliergram (MBD vs MEI parabolic fence). [VERIFIED: tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1198/jcgs.2011.09224 — confirmed Sun & Genton 2011, JCGS Vol 20 No 2, pp 316-334.] NOT the category-level dispatcher depth.functional_depth. curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page verification of title/authors.

dai_genton_2019.title: Directional outlyingness for multivariate functional data
dai_genton_2019.notes: Introduces directional outlyingness (magnitude-shape outlyingness) and the MS-plot (MUOD). [CITED: sciencedirect.com — Dai & Genton 2019, CSDA.] curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page verification.

febrero_galeano_gonzalez_2008.title: Outlier detection in functional data by depth measures with application to identify abnormal NOx levels
febrero_galeano_gonzalez_2008.notes: Depth-based likelihood ratio test (LRT) for outlier detection in functional data. [CITED: onlinelibrary.wiley.com — Febrero, Galeano, González-Manteiga 2008, Environmetrics.] curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page verification.

_uncurated_outliers_2026-09.notes: Pending curation — attribution partially confirmed from fdars-core source. tvdmss: fdars-core 0.33 outliers.rs doc says 'Huang & Sun 2019 / fdaoutlier::tvdmss' but DOI not identified. depthgram: fdars-core source says 'roahd depthGram' — [ASSUMED] Dai & Genton 2018 JCGS (different paper from Dai & Genton 2019 CSDA). sequential_transform_outliers: no paper citation in fdars-core source. All three deferred to 81-05 curated:false family or future direct verification.

muller_stadtmuller_2005.title: Generalized functional linear models
muller_stadtmuller_2005.notes: Introduces the generalized functional linear model (logistic, Poisson, etc.) via FPCA reduction. [VERIFIED: projecteuclid.org — AoS Vol 33, No 2, 2005, DOI 10.1214/009053604000001156] curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page personal verification.

ferraty_vieu_2006.title: Nonparametric Functional Data Analysis
ferraty_vieu_2006.notes: Canonical monograph on nonparametric functional regression (kernel-based). Also covers kernel classification methods. [CITED: link.springer.com/book/10.1007/0-387-36620-2 — Ferraty & Vieu, Springer Series in Statistics, 2006.] curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page verification.

preda_saporta_2005.title: PLS regression on a stochastic process
preda_saporta_2005.notes: Introduces functional PLS (partial least squares) regression. [ASSUMED] — DOI 10.1016/j.csda.2004.07.002 is plausible but not landing-page-verified this session; curated:false until confirmed.

pini_vantini_2016.title: The interval testing procedure: A general framework for inference in functional data analysis
pini_vantini_2016.notes: Introduces the Interval Testing Procedure (ITP) for point-wise and interval inference on functional data. [CITED: onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/biom.12476 — Biometrics 2016.] The 2016 Biometrics paper is the primary framework reference (NOT the 2017 companion in J.Nonparametric Statistics). curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page personal verification.

degras_2011.title: Simultaneous confidence bands for nonparametric regression with functional data
degras_2011.notes: Introduces simultaneous confidence bands (SCB) for nonparametric regression with functional data. [CITED: stat.sinica.edu.tw — Statistica Sinica 21(4):1735-1765, 2011, DOI 10.5705/ss.2009.207.] No standalone CRAN package found (cross_language omitted — honest gap). curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page personal verification.

cuevas_febrero_fraiman_2004.title: An ANOVA test for functional data
cuevas_febrero_fraiman_2004.notes: Introduces permutation-based ANOVA F-test and t-test for functional data (functional permutation testing framework). [CITED: sciencedirect.com — CSDA 47(1):111-122, 2004.] curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page personal verification.

_uncurated_inference_flmftest_2026-09.notes: FLM F-test and GoF test for scalar-on-function model. fdars-core inference/flm.rs uses a classical FPC-based R² F-statistic (not the functional projection F-test of Shen & Faraway 2004 or the generalized FLM test of Müller & Stadtmüller 2005). The GoF test is a RESET-style polynomial auxiliary regression — standard econometrics, no FDA-specific paper. No explicit paper citation found in fdars-core source. curated:false — do not force-cite Shen & Faraway 2004.

cuesta_albertos_febrero_2010.title: A simple multiway ANOVA for functional data
cuesta_albertos_febrero_2010.notes: V-statistic functional ANOVA. Contested attribution: primary candidates are Cuesta-Albertos & Febrero-Bande (2010) TEST and Górecki & Smaga (2015) Comput. Stat. (DOI 10.1007/s00180-015-0555-0). fdars-core inference/anova.rs uses V = ∫ Σ_g n_g (x̄_g(t) − x̄(t))² dt with Satterthwaite/Box scaled-χ² approximation but cites NO specific paper in the source. Both 2010 and 2015 papers describe V-statistic approaches. Executor must check fdars-core source for the specific V-statistic formula used. curated:false pending fdars-core source confirmation of the dominant reference.

_uncurated_regression_robust_2026-09.notes: Robust regression adaptation (L1/Huber) for functional data. No single canonical FDA primary paper identified for these specific callables. fdars-core source has no explicit citation. curated:false — do not force-cite.

petersen_muller_2019.title: Fréchet regression for random objects with Euclidean predictors
petersen_muller_2019.notes: Introduces global and local Fréchet regression for random objects (including distributions and covariance matrices) with Euclidean predictors. [VERIFIED: projecteuclid.org — AoS Vol 47, No 2, 2019, pp 691-719, DOI 10.1214/17-AOS1624.] No direct R or Python standalone implementation found as of 2026-09-07 (cross_language omitted — honest gap). curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page personal verification.

petersen_muller_2016.title: Functional data analysis for density functions by transformation to a Hilbert space
petersen_muller_2016.notes: Introduces the log-quantile density (LQD) transform for functional data analysis of density functions. [ASSUMED] — DOI 10.1214/15-AOS1363 is plausible; not personally landing-page-verified this session. curated:false until confirmed.

agueh_carlier_2011.title: Barycenters in the Wasserstein space
agueh_carlier_2011.notes: Introduces barycenters in the Wasserstein space (Fréchet mean w.r.t. the 2-Wasserstein distance). [ASSUMED] — DOI 10.1137/100805741 and SIAM SIOPT URL are plausible; not personally landing-page-verified this session. curated:false until confirmed.

_uncurated_regression_fof_2026-09.notes: Function-on-function regression via double FPCA. fdars-core fof_regression.rs cites multiple co-primaries: Ramsay & Silverman 2005 Ch.16-17, Yao/Müller/Wang 2005 AoS 33(6):2873-2903, and Ivanescu et al. 2015 Comput.Stat. No single primary root — curated:false pending fdars-core source confirmation of the dominant reference.

yao_muller_wang_2005.title: Functional data analysis for sparse longitudinal data
yao_muller_wang_2005.notes: PACE (Principal Analysis via Conditional Expectation) for sparse/irregular functional data. [VERIFIED: tandfonline.com — Yao, Müller, Wang 2005, JASA Vol 100, No 470, pp 577-590.] curated:false until Phase 84 direct DOI-landing-page verification.
